failures_and_recoveries.failure_summary: The newly declared myis-a1.2 console entry point was unavailable in the existing no-sync environment.
failures_and_recoveries.recovery_summary: The same CLI was executed through its Python module and the 16-file scaffold validation passed.

failures_and_recoveries.failure_summary: The repository-safe MLflow doctor found the historical fixture store before the ArmIndex experiment registry existed.
failures_and_recoveries.recovery_summary: A zero-data metadata-only bootstrap added the active ArmIndex experiment; the doctor then passed all checks with no dataset access or scientific metrics.

failures_and_recoveries.failure_summary: The first full-suite process exceeded the command runner's 124-second limit without reporting a test failure.
failures_and_recoveries.recovery_summary: The unchanged suite was rerun with a longer command envelope and all 414 tests passed.

failures_and_recoveries.failure_summary: An unconfigured extended Ruff profile exposed pre-existing modernize and exception-style debt, including byte-bound scaffold sources.
failures_and_recoveries.recovery_summary: The scoped correctness profile E4, E7, E9, and F passed; immutable scaffold bytes were preserved and style debt was not misreported as a correctness failure.

failures_and_recoveries.failure_summary: The first closeout-audit report integration reopened the audit from the filesystem and failed in a temporary projection checkout.
failures_and_recoveries.recovery_summary: Failure and recovery records now flow through the one validated read-model object shared by every projection writer.

failures_and_recoveries.failure_summary: The first post-commit sync receipt still selected the completed A1.1 adapter receipt as its latest ArmIndex source.
failures_and_recoveries.recovery_summary: The sync receipt and MLflow archive now bind the validated A1.2 scaffold receipt and closeout audit while keeping launch and measured execution false.

failures_and_recoveries.failure_summary: The first immutable closeout audit copied additive MLflow archive counts that increased during later deterministic report syncs.
failures_and_recoveries.recovery_summary: The audit now records the stable doctor check result without freezing volatile archive counts; append-only MLflow receipts remain authoritative in the external store.
